Surface amendment · 2026-11-10T17:54Z · claim 6774916690

- File surface widened by two test files, no source: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.hydration.test.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useChatConversation.test.tsx`.
- Why (the card thread's reading): `ObjectQuerySourceSchema` requires `line` and `scope`, and the console's chat cache stores the lifted block and re-lifts it on reload through `detectAnswerSource`. So the lift returns the whole parsed block, and those two pins (an old projection; a fixture without `line` that was never contract-legal) move with it. Without this, every cached source panel would vanish after a reload.
- Condition: the runtime import of `@objectstack/spec` schema code into `mapMessages.ts` (eager `/core` entry) must not grow any first-load chunk; `check:eager-closure` is measured and reported. If it grows, the thread stops and reports options before landing.

Surface amendment 2 · 2026-11-10T18:13Z · claim 6774916690

- Reading (card thread, two console builds on one tree): with the reader on `ObjectQuerySourceSchema`, the eager closure grows +670 B gz (`vendor-objectstack` +785 B) because `mapMessages.ts` sits in the eager `plugin-chatbot-core` group: `core.ts` re-exports three parsers from it. That fails this seat's condition in amendment 6774967421.
- Ruling: option A. The three parsers and `parseResultEnvelope` move into one new `plugin-chatbot/src` module; `core.ts` imports from it; the `plugin-chatbot-core` group in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` names the new module instead of `mapMessages`, so the schema loads only with the lazy chat. The surface widens by `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/core.ts`, that one new file and that one `vite.config.ts` line. Both legs are re-measured; the eager closure must not grow.
- Serial: `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` is also in `domain:ui#2`'s PR #32255 (#32225). This card lands after #32255 merges, by a merge of `main` and a re-measure.
